tools.name: search_drinks
tools.description: Text search over energy drink names and brands. Returns up to 10 matching drinks with caffeine, sugar and a link to each drink page, or no results when EnergyDrinkRatings has no entry for the name.

tools.name: get_drink
tools.description: Full label facts for one drink identified by its EDR slug: caffeine, sugar, calories, serving size, sweetener and flavor info, availability, the community rating with its count and, when there are enough written reviews, a one-line summary of what raters say. Also returns links to the drink page, to

tools.name: compare_drinks
tools.description: Side-by-side facts for 2-4 drinks by slug. Slugs not found in the catalog are reported, not silently dropped.

tools.name: find_drinks
tools.description: Filters the catalog by caffeine, sugar, sweetener type, flavor family, carbonation and extras, with the same filters as energydrinkratings.com/find. Returns only available drinks, ranked by real community rating where rated, then by name, along with the total number of matches.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "compare_drinks" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Side-by-side facts for 2-4 drinks by slug. Slugs not found in the catalog are reported, not silently dropped.
